results.title: GenPage 3.0: The Landing Page Revenue Engine for GTM Teams · GenPage Blog
results.content:
## Landing pages deserve to be treated like product

Your landing pages are where the first impression happens. Where trust is established or lost. Where prospects qualify themselves in or out. Where the promise your ad or your SDR made either gets kept or quietly broken.

Functionally it's your first sales conversation, running at a scale no human team could cover. Your pages take more meetings in a day than your entire sales org takes in a quarter.

And almost every company treats them as static, one-time projects. Built once, signed off, forgotten. [...] That's the bar. 3.0 is the first version where we think we're consistently clearing it.

Person Based Marketing example: a 1:1 landing page annotated with the research behind each personalized element

## What's next

GenPage Autopilot - Level 4 - is currently in private beta with a small group of customers alongside heavy internal testing. It generates new variants of a page, splits sessions across them, measures conversion performance, and converges on a winner over a defined number of rounds. Continuous optimization without anyone designing a test, building a variant, or interpreting significance. [...] ### GenPage for Google Ads is out of beta

Search is where intent is most explicit: someone typing a query is telling you exactly what they want, which makes sending them to a generic destination especially expensive.

After months of iteration we're genuinely happy with the quality of the pages being generated, and it's ready for everyone. Connect Google Ads, import your campaigns, keywords, and ad groups, generate matching landing pages, publish at scale, and track performance down to each individual variant.

GenPage for Google Ads generating landing page variants mapped to campaigns and keywords

### The GenPage MCP is live

Our API has been completely rebuilt, and GenPage now works in both directions.

results.title: Changelog · GenPage Updates & New Features
results.content:
Most companies spend enormous amounts driving traffic through ads, outbound, and demand generation, then send that traffic to generic website experiences that were never built for the person clicking.

GenPage 3.0 is a major step toward changing that - making landing pages smarter, easier to create, deeply connected to your GTM stack, and eventually able to continuously optimize themselves.

## What's new [...] A cleaner GenPage experience: We’ve redesigned and refined several parts of the app, including Settings, the Overview, and the Canvas. Navigation is cleaner, important actions are easier to reach, and the Overview now includes quick starting points to help new users get going faster and existing users discover more of what GenPage can do. [...] The GenPage MCP is now live: Use external MCP tools inside GenPage, or connect GenPage directly to tools like Claude to generate landing pages from workflows, CRM records, call transcripts, and more.
 12 new templates: Our previous template library has been replaced with a completely new collection of modern, higher-quality designs.
 Major AI and personalization upgrades: GenPage 3.0 brings together our latest generation system, deeper enrichments, model selection, Variables Agent, improved brand intelligence, and the new performance overview.
 Ads module and credit top-ups: Ads is now available as a module priced on the ad spend GenPage optimizes. You can also purchase additional credits instantly whenever you need extra capacity, without changing plans.
